narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On September 3, 2024, at approximately 0550 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] conducted an immigration inspection of a gray minivan at the request of the Michigan State Police following a traffic stop near Marshall, Michigan. Three men were in the vehicle.
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], the driver and the subject of this record, stated that he is a citizen of Mexico without documents and that he entered the United States illegally near Sasabe, Arizona, in October 2016.
The front passenger, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that he crossed in 2013, and the rear passenger, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that he crossed in 2019. Both passengers are documented on separate records.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
All three men were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station and processed for Notices to Appear.
